CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERSTATUS_SEC
AS
BEGIN
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
,
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus
AS(
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BSC.STATUS AS CustomerStatusTypeId
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,CustomerStatusTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,CustomerStatusTypeId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerStatus WHERE SOURCECODE = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC';

---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerStatus  ( 
CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerStatusNote
,CustomerStatusTypeId
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerStatusNote
,SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId AS CustomerStatusTypeId
,SRC.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCECODE
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId

 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerStatus  ( 
CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerStatusNote
,CustomerStatusTypeId
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 CustomerId AS CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerStatusNote
,CustomerStatusTypeId AS CustomerStatusTypeId
,SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCECODE
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA;

END
